hook: A paralyzed man is playing *GTA VI with his mind* through a Neuralink brain implant
caption:
Neuralink posted a clip of a trial participant playing GTA VI one day after the game came out.
He is paralyzed and used to play on an iPad with a mouth stick. Now the implant turns imagined hand and finger movements into controller buttons.
In the clip he steers a speedboat under a bridge to pick up a package.
The implant is still experimental and not approved by the FDA.

Would you get a brain chip to game with your mind?
